lead.title: Conversational Gemini navigation comes to Apple CarPlay

The conversational Gemini in navigation is available today for US drivers, with "rollout happening globally too," according to Google (we've asked for specific regional…

news.title: ServiceNow and Nvidia launch Arc, a personal, long-running enterprise AI agent for productivity tasks across email and Teams, for RTX Spark and Nvidia OpenShell
news.summary: The two companies are trying to solve the AI agent security conundrum with multiple layers of real-time security checks.

news.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 26 additional countries, taking the total to 83 countries, and says the platform's advertiser base is 100K+, up from 20K in August

news.title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers

news.author: Lily Hay Newman

news.title: Jensen Huang’s Vision for Europe Runs on Plug-In Data Centers

news.author: Tom Bristow

news.title: Nvidia’s latest GPU driver brings a new way to speed up PC games
news.summary: Nvidia is rolling out a new GPU driver today (621.01) that enables Microsoft's new Advanced Shader Delivery technology to speed up game launches. The technology also removes mid-game "just-in-time" shader compilation, reducing stuttering and CPU spikes. Microsoft's Advanced Shader Delivery works by…
news.author: Tom Warren

news.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
news.summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

news.title: Claude flagged 493 security issues across 25 open-source projects, covering 5M+ lines of C, C++, Java, PHP, and Python code; one went unnoticed for 21 years
news.summary: Over the past year, we've published lots of data that shows that frontier AI models are more than capable of discovering and exploiting security vulnerabilities.

news.title: PHP's creators disclose a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed "PHP2Shell", that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered via GPT-5.6 Sol in August

papers.title: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
papers.summary: DecisionPivot is a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates decision models across controlled variations, revealing gaps between aggregate accuracy, contrast-group performance, calibration, and reasoning effort.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
papers.summary: S-Agent 2.0 improves spatial reasoning by integrating a persistent scene memory and plain-language interpretation into a coding agent with 3D perception tools.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 86 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
papers.summary: Ropedia W0 is a world foundation model for cross-embodiment loco-manipulation that unifies human and robot data via kinematic representations and achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse benchmarks.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 123 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: Event-STVG: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding for Long-Form Event Reasoning
papers.summary: Event-STVG introduces a challenging benchmark requiring multimodal models to perform long-form event reasoning, repeated-event disambiguation, and multi-target spatio-temporal grounding across extended video contexts.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.title: EvaOmni: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Audio-Visual Reasoning
papers.summary: EvaOmni is an evidence-grounded benchmark that evaluates whether omnimodal language models identify audio-visual evidence and construct reasoning chains for audiovisual questions.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
papers.summary: CoEvo-RSI reduces brain-body mismatch in recursive self-improving agents by using bidirectional historical inheritance to align model capabilities with evolving harness requirements, achieving strong results via supervised fine-tuning.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 57 upvotes no Hugging Face.
